name: Scout's Binoculars
text: Before bidding, reveal two random cards in each opponent's hand.

signature.target: two random cards in each opponent's hand

archetypes: High Card, Exact Contractor, Nil Champion; splash Contract Attacker
decision: Bidding: whether a king or queen is a trick (Unclouded Sun only protects aces), whether to go nil against the high cards you saw, and how many tricks to bid for an exact count.
opponent: The revealed cards are shown to the whole table and stay revealed for the round; opponents' play is unaffected, but your partner bids with the information too.
aiNote: Count a seen opponent ace or higher trump in a suit as costing your matching king or queen its trick; don't bid nil if a seen card is a low card of your longest suit that could force you over.
rationale: Four random cards out of 26, shown to your whole team, sharpen both bids without settling them, so it is modest at a common and distinct from BL-C07 (after bidding, shape) and Scrying Orb (during play).
